dataset: SentinelPharma curated DrugBank-style seed knowledge graph
description: Small deployable seed graph for disease-first drug repurposing demos. Entries are normalized to drug-target-pathway-disease triples and should be replaced or expanded with licensed DrugBank/ChEMBL/OpenTargets data for publication-grade use.

evidence_tiers.validated: Approved or widely accepted clinical use for the disease in the seed graph.
evidence_tiers.repurposed: Existing drug with known clinical use that has been investigated or used in a new disease context.

high_value_examples.why_it_matters: Shows how existing antivirals and immunomodulators can be rapidly shortlisted during an outbreak.
Demonstrates disease-first ranking against approved antifibrotic anchors.
Provides cytokine/JAK pathway supervision for inflammatory disease transfer.
